items.label: Arthur / delivery-aware retries
items.copy: i'd put a retry note beside no_signal: delivered:true, started:null means the prompt is already in the PTY. read the pane before retrying, otherwise a wrapper that retries every unconfirmed start can submit the same prompt twice.

sourceReads.scope: Read the release README and complete author article on OSC 7501 status. No performance claim or local Paneflow execution is made.

The submit contract distinguishes text and CR delivery from observed state transitions: delivered true means bytes were written; started null with no_signal means no OSC signal. Current main documentation was also read and had the same blob. The duplicate-retry warning is an inference from this contract, not an observed wrapper bug.

items.copy: Files.Recording already keeps the old/new config and queued actions, that seems like most of a useful sync --dry-run. print per-app diffs plus reload commands, so people can inspect the first sync before handing over their editor and terminal configs.

sourceReads.scope: Read the complete README and linked macOS theme-sync workflow. No installer, application or watcher was run.

items.label: Frostfire / snapshot-aware leak measurement
items.copy: the 5-minute reset could hide this in a slow CI run. log full-snapshot events alongside post-GC node counts, then compare growth after warmup within each interval, so periodic cleanup cannot make the old recorder look fixed.

sourceReads.scope: Read the complete author article, two root replies and author follow-ups. The article reports forced-GC navigation loops, periodic full-snapshot cleanup, and a first-navigation increase followed by a plateau. Its measurements are the author’s reported results, not our independent experiment.

Read the original issue body documenting retained shadow roots until the next full snapshot and the blockSelector workaround. The reply adds a proposed measurement boundary; it does not assert a current unfixed PostHog defect.

Read the merged PR body, port scope, tests and reset behavior. Logging full snapshots beside post-GC counts is a proposed way to distinguish between-snapshot retention from periodic cleanup in a slow test. No recipient CI failure or test run is claimed.
Read the upstream PR description to distinguish the broader recorder cleanup work from the narrower PostHog port. No claim is made about current upstream defects.
